purpose: A horizontal bar that shows how far an operation that takes more than a couple of seconds has got, from 0 to 100. Pair it with a label and the percentage.

notFor.case: A bar does not fit (a button, a card corner, an avatar).
A measured value against a range, not progress toward completion.

Default.visual: Track Surface/muted; bar Action/primary/default (solid) or a gradient from Action/primary/default to Action/primary/hover (gradient).

notes: The bar width moves on use-progress (recipes/motion.ts).

openQuestions: Indeterminate: Radix reports it when there is no value, but no look is designed. What does it show?
Reduced motion: should the bar jump to the new value instead of moving on use-progress?
